name: pillar_morph
desc: The pink marbled goo pillar holding the small black witch cat slowly bubbles and squelches, swelling and bulging, goo lumps grow outward into huge muscular arms spreading sideways and a grinning toothy crocodile head with spikes rises up behind the cat, gradually transforming into a macho paint crocodile monster that holds the cat in its chest. Gooey, wet, gradual transformation.
